subject: Re: Redwood pricing estimate & cost model for Acme
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-10 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (token volumes & budget)

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the asks I promised to follow up on: 

- Your primary use case: customer support assistant + in-product help (short prompts, ~1k tokens per session peak, average 150 tokens).
- Expected volume: pilot ≈ 5M tokens/month, roll to prod ≈ 50M tokens/month (concurrent growth over 3 months).
- Embeddings: used for similarity routing and reranking. Estimated 10M embedding tokens/month (short sequences).
- Key constraint: target cost ~ $100 / 1M tokens net to your finance team (budget range: $75–$125 / 1M) for production.
- Requirements: SOC 2 evidence, option for private deployment or dedicated capacity, and predictable unit economics.

Next steps I will take:
1) Send a quick estimate spreadsheet with line-item cost breakdown (compute, infra, support). (attached)
2) Run a short cost model showing list vs reserved (12-month) pricing and how volume commitments move the $/1M token.
3) Introduce Marissa (Customer Success) for onboarding & SLA questions if you want to proceed.

Can you confirm: the 50M tokens/month target is the steady-state you want pricing for, and whether embeddings should be priced separately in your model? Once confirmed, I’ll share an invoice-style estimate you can show Procurement.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: Acme_Redwood_QuickEstimate_20260310.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet – cost sketch)
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-10 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (token volumes & budget)

Sean — thanks for the recap. Yes — 50M tokens/month steady state is what finance cares about for the business case. A few clarifications: 

- The 50M number includes both generation and embedding tokens, but we’d prefer to see embeddings broken out separately so we can map to the vector DB spend.
- Target budget: finance mentioned ~$100 / 1M tokens as a negotiation anchor. If reserved pricing can get us close to $80–90 / 1M at scale, that would be compelling.
- Can you provide an example invoice for 50M tokens and one for 5M tokens (pilot)? Procurement will want line items (model, infra, data transfer, support).

Also looping in procurement (procurement@acme.com) for timeline — we’re aiming to finalize vendor selection by end of month.

—Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of Product Platforms, Acme Corp
alex.jenkins@acme.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-12 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme pricing estimate & cost model (attached)

Alex / team — thanks, and appreciate the clarity. Attached is a more detailed estimate and a pricing calculator you can edit in your own sheet: 
- Acme_Redwood_Estimate_20260312.xlsx — invoice-style estimate for pilot (5M tokens) and steady-state (50M tokens), plus tiered $/1M tokens.
- pricing_calculator_20260312.csv — simplified CSV cost inputs so your finance model can plug in different volumes.
- Shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAcmeCostModel (editable view)

Key assumptions and line-item breakdown (summary):
- Model inference: $80 / 1M tokens (list) — based on redwood-1-large serving profile for 150-token average prompts.
- Infra & hosting (GPU amortization, autoscaling): $20 / 1M tokens (list).
- Network, storage, logging: $5 / 1M tokens.
- Support & SLA premium (24x7, 99.9% target): $10 / 1M tokens.
- Total list price: $115 / 1M tokens.

Reserved / committed pricing (12-month commit) — typical discounts applied: 20% off total list => $92 / 1M tokens.

Example invoice estimates (rounded):
- Pilot (5M tokens/month) — list: $575 / month; reserved discount: $460 / month.
- Steady-state (50M tokens/month) — list: $5,750 / month; reserved discount: $4,600 / month.

Embeddings & reranking note: embeddings are charged at a different effective rate due to shorter sequences; in the attached sheet we model embeddings at $30 / 1M tokens (list) and $24 / 1M tokens (reserved). You’ll see an embeddings line separate from generation in the invoice.

If your finance target is ~$100 / 1M tokens, you hit that with the list price of $115 but can meet or beat it with a reserved commit (we can get to ~$92 / 1M). If you need ~$80–90 / 1M, we can model an expanded commit or a multi-year contract — I’ve left a variable in the calculator for percent discount at different commit levels.

Requested next steps: 
1) Let me know which steady-state scenario you want priced (50M tokens with embeddings included vs. embeddings billed separately).
2) If procurement prefers an invoice PDF, I can generate a formal estimate with line-item billing codes and PO info.
3) Marissa will follow up on onboarding questions and SOC 2 evidence.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
Attachment: Acme_Redwood_Estimate_20260312.xlsx (detailed estimate)
Attachment: pricing_calculator_20260312.csv (editable inputs)
From: procurement@acme.com <procurement@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-12 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme pricing estimate & cost model (attached)

Thanks for the estimate. Procurement here — a few items we need before we can route to legal for an SOW: 

1) Final invoice template with PO number field and billing contact (please include Redwood's remit-to details).
2) Confirmation of the reserved discount schedule (we need a table: 3mo/6mo/12mo commit => discount %).
3) SOC 2 report PDF and data processing addendum (DPA) copy.

For the commercial ask — our CFO is comfortable with $95 / 1M tokens if that includes embeddings and comes with a 12-month commit. Can you confirm whether $95 is achievable with a 12-month reserved commitment and initial 3-month ramp? If so, we can proceed to PO.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com
